thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: CACHE_STALE_ALERT triggered for us-east-1 prefix KVs; elevated stale-response rate reported by monitoring. Paging @sam.k and @devon. Incident ID 1766.
sam.k: Acknowledged. seeing increases in stale-hit metric for prefixes starting with /model/v2/seq. Customers reporting old completions.
devon: I'm on call. pulling logs and checking recent jobs. Any compaction/restore actions in last 6h?
infra-team: We started a cross-zone snapshot sync at 01:05Z and an asynchronous compaction at 02:30Z. Could be overlap.
devon: Initial inspection: prefix-version divergence across nodes; some nodes report head=1012 while others still serve 1009.
monitoring-bot: metric:prefix_stale_rate(us-east-1)=0.9% peak, baseline <0.05%. alert threshold 0.25%.
sam.k: Customer impact: cs-lina — which tenants impacted?
cs-lina: Two paying tenants (tenant_beta, tenant_gamma) reported stale completions for ~1% of requests in last 20 minutes. They're P2 but asking for prompt updates.
devon: Mitigation strategy suggestion: 1) flip per-tenant feature-flag to force read-through to origin for affected tenants 2) enable temporary global cache-safe-mode for prefix reads while we reconcile 3) reduce RPS for fanout-heavy endpoints to limit exposure.
sam.k: Prefer tenant-scoped first. Global mode could cause perf regressions. Let's do tenant flags + targeted traffic shaping + node isolation.
ops-bot: runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/prefix-cache-incident
devon: Executing tenant flag toggle for tenant_beta and tenant_gamma:
```
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --tenant tenant_beta --feature prefix_read_passthrough --on --reason "incident 1766"
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --tenant tenant_gamma --feature prefix_read_passthrough --on --reason "incident 1766"
```
deploy-bot: feature-toggle applied tenant_beta=true tenant_gamma=true status=ok
devon: Passthrough enabled. Observing immediate drop in stale responses for those tenants (0.2% -> 0.01%).
sam.k: Next, perform traffic shaping on the heavy endpoints for all tenants to limit blast radius:
```
redwoodctl traffic-shape add --path "/v1/generate*" --rate 50rps --scope region:us-east-1 --reason "containment 1766"
```
deploy-bot: traffic-shape added id=shp-88 scope=us-east-1 status=applied
monitoring-bot: inbound QPS for /v1/generate on us-east-1 dropped 40% after shape applied. error-rate reduced.
infra-team: We'll cordon two nodes serving old versions: node-e1-07 and node-e1-19 then run a fast reconcile job to rehydrate their prefix index.
devon: Draining nodes then starting rehydrate:
```
infractl cordon node-e1-07 node-e1-19 --reason "suspected stale-serving"
infractl rehydrate-prefix --nodes node-e1-07,node-e1-19 --target head=1012 --concurrency 2
```
ops-bot: cordon initiated; rehydrate job rh-992 started. ETA ~10m.
monitoring-bot: after cordon, 5xx and stale metrics dropped cluster-wide by ~70% within 90s.
sam.k: CS update drafted: "We detected intermittent stale responses for a small portion of requests. We've enabled a temporary read-through for affected tenants, throttled heavy endpoints, and are reconciling nodes. No user data loss." cs-lina to send after mitigation confirmed.
cs-lina: Sending now.
devon: Rehydrate job completed; nodes at head=1012. Running parity check.
monitoring-bot: parity-check: node-e1-07 head=1012 node-e1-19 head=1012 all-other-nodes head=1012. prefix_stale_rate back to 0.02%.
sam.k: Decision: revert tenant passthrough after 30m of stability to restore performance. Also remove traffic-shape if stable.
ops-bot: scheduling handoff: @devon will monitor for 20m then hand to @infra-team for 1h observation.
devon: I'll keep eyes on it. A couple of follow-ups: - add pre-compaction gating to prevent compaction if disparity >1 version - improve alerting to detect prefix-version divergence earlier - add a per-tenant safety net that auto-routes to origin if stale rate spikes above 0.2%
infra-team: noted. We'll open tickets and prioritize the gating fix.
cs-lina: Customers acknowledged the update and requested a follow-up postmortem.
sam.k: Lifting temporary controls in stages: remove traffic-shape, then toggle feature flag off for tenants after stability.
deploy-bot: traffic-shape shp-88 removed; feature-toggle tenant_beta set=false tenant_gamma set=false status=ok
monitoring-bot: 60m post-mitigation stale rate avg=0.01% < baseline threshold.
sam.k: Incident summary: duration ~36m; severity P2; mitigations: tenant passthrough toggles, traffic shaping, node cordon + rehydrate. No data loss, limited customer impact.
incident-bot: Incident CLOSED | responders: sam.k, devon, infra-team, cs-lina | duration 36m | follow-up tickets: COMP-3421 (compaction gating), ALERT-829 (version divergence alert), SAFE-210 (per-tenant safety net).
cs-lina: Scheduling customer postmortem call for 10:00AM EST.
devon: I'll own the internal postmortem writeup.
sam.k: Thanks everyone. Back to normal ops.
